mapper.select: select f.id, f.object_type, f.name, f.api_name, f.title, f.type, f.biz_type, f.expression, f.trigger_expr, f.virtual_expr, f.write_back_expr::text as write_back_expr, f.refer_info::text as refer_info, t.app_name from baseapp_object_field f left join baseapp_object_type t on f.object_type = t.name where f.object_type = #{objectType}

select f.id, f.object_type, f.name, f.api_name, f.title, f.type, f.biz_type, f.expression, f.trigger_expr, f.virtual_expr, f.write_back_expr::text as write_back_expr, f.refer_info::text as refer_info, t.app_name from baseapp_object_field f left join baseapp_object_type t on f.object_type = t.name where f.write_back_expr is not null

select f.id, f.object_type, f.name, f.api_name, f.title, f.type, f.biz_type, f.expression, f.trigger_expr, f.virtual_expr, f.write_back_expr::text as write_back_expr, f.refer_info::text as refer_info, f.source_info::text as source_info, null as description, null as enum_type, null as is_disabled, null as is_master_field, t.app_name from baseapp_object_field f left join baseapp_object_type t on f.object_type = t.name

select m.content::text from baseapp_system_metadata m join baseapp_object_type t on m.name = t.name where m.name like '%View%' and m.is_deleted = false and m.type_id = 'MetaType.entity' and coalesce(t.type, '') = 'bill' and lower(coalesce(t.app_name, '')) in ('arap','purchase', 'sales', 'contract')
select app_name from baseapp_object_type where name = #{objectType} limit 1
select name, title, type, description, is_disabled from baseapp_object_type
select name from baseapp_object_type where coalesce(type,'') = 'bill'

SELECT f.id, f.object_type, f.name, f.api_name, f.title, f.type, f.biz_type, f.refer_info::text as refer_info, t.app_name FROM baseapp_object_field f LEFT JOIN baseapp_object_type t ON f.object_type = t.name WHERE f.refer_info IS NOT NULL AND f.refer_info::text != 'null' AND jsonb_typeof(f.refer_info->'referEntities') = 'array' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(f.refer_info->'referEntities') AS elem WHERE elem->>'referEntityName' = #{entityName} ) ORDER BY f.object_type, f.name
SELECT m.content::text FROM baseapp_system_metadata m WHERE m.is_deleted = false AND lower(m.type_id) LIKE '%enum%'

SELECT f.object_type, f.name, f.type, f.source_info::text as source_info, f.refer_info::text as refer_info FROM baseapp_object_field f WHERE f.type = 'LIST' AND f.source_info IS NOT NULL AND f.source_info::text != 'null'
select m.name from baseapp_system_metadata m where m.is_deleted = false and m.type_id = 'MetaType.entity' and m.content::jsonb->>'isSupportChangeBill' = 'true'
select m.name, m.content::text as content from baseapp_system_metadata m where m.is_deleted = false and m.type_id = 'MetaType.entity' and m.content is not null

SELECT otfu.id, fu.name AS func_unit_name, fu.method_step_type, fu.exec_base_method, fu.func_unit_type_id FROM baseapp_object_type_func_unit otfu JOIN baseapp_func_unit fu ON otfu.func_unit_id = fu.id WHERE otfu.object_type = #{entityName} AND otfu.is_deleted = false AND fu.is_deleted = false

SELECT ebr.id, ebr.rule_id, ebr.is_binding_use, ebr.is_disabled, a.func_unit_name, coalesce(nullif(btas.func_unit_step, ''), a.func_unit_step) as func_unit_step, a.func_unit_type_id, t.base_method as trigger_base_method, a.live_style_id as action_spec_style_id FROM baseapp_entity_business_rule ebr JOIN baseapp_entity_rule_trigger ert ON ert.entity_rule_id = ebr.id JOIN baseapp_business_trigger_action_spec btas ON ert.trigger_id = btas.trigger_id JOIN baseapp_business_trigger t ON btas.trigger_id = t.id JOIN baseapp_business_action_spec a ON btas.action_spec_id = a.id WHERE ebr.object_type = #{entityName} AND ebr.is_deleted = false AND coalesce(ebr.is_disabled, false) = false AND a.live_style_id = 'PLUGIN' AND a.func_unit_name IS NOT NULL AND a.func_unit_name != ''
SELECT id, name, object_type FROM baseapp_pre_do_rule_group WHERE object_type = #{entityName} AND is_deleted = false LIMIT 10
